subject: planner: fix privilege for the view in the CTE and  wrong error handle (#53556)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: (1) `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go` now preserves `plannererrors.ErrNotSupportedYet` from view expansion instead of rewriting it to `ErrViewInvalid`, matching expected SQL error semantics; (2) `pkg/privilege/privileges/privileges.go` treats an empty `*auth.UserIdentity` (both username/hostname empty, e.g. unresolved CURRENT_USER placeholder) as allow in `RequestVerificationWithUser`, aligning with existing “empty current user => allow” behavior used for internal/test sessions. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched planner/privilege behavior.
